title: WebGL Graphics Architecture, Motion Parallax & Zero-Asset Presentation
core_competencies: Motion parallax engineering: using high-contrast textures, curbs, and camera lag to convey velocity.
Procedural audio synthesis: Web Audio API tone synthesis for footsteps, ambience, and fanfares.
WebGL performance budgets: maintaining under 120 draw calls via instancing and texture atlas reuse.
UI legibility: high-contrast HUDs, radar minimaps, and physical billboard nameplates.
anti_patterns: Rigid camera locking that causes visual stagnation.
Uncached canvas textures creating frame drops.
